summary: Iteration 2 covers all four new features (10-case pack, dual radiographs, X-ray-blended Test Stewardship scoring, tooth findings map, LLM case generation, and OpenAI TTS voice) plus regression. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (30.6s) — /api/cases returns >=10 authored ids and generated flag; cracked-tooth & periodontitis both expose 2 has_xray tests scoring the correct library options (fracture/normal, bone_loss/caries); scoring endpoint returns test_stewardship.xray_findings (list) + xray_score {correct,total} and Testing dimension = 15/15 when both indicated X-rays ordered and answered correctly, drops to ~60% when answers are wrong; exam response includes 'severity'; /api/cases/generate?lang=en returned a playable case with 4 dx / 4 tx / >=1 has_xray; /api/tts returned real audio base64 (>1000 chars) for TR and EN. Frontend: full user flow on cracked-tooth passed — landing shows 12 cards initially incl. all 10 authored ids and prior generated ones, clicking generate-case-btn added a new card (gen-* testid, AI badge visible via generated flag); voice toggle ON triggered POST /api/tts after patient reply; Muayene phase places tooth-marker-{n} on the odontogram after an exam; Testler phase renders both xray-image-{periapical_xray,bitewing} images, xray-opt buttons and xray-explanation-{testId} panels; Debrief shows total-score=68, dim-testing bar 15/15, and two xray-finding-{i} entries labelled correct/incorrect.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L26: LLM_MODEL still ('gemini','gemini-3-flash-preview') — an odd/likely-invalid model id; if the client rejects it llm_call returns None and features silently fall back (patient dialogue → canned reply, examiner narrative → deterministic, case generation → 502). During this run LLM calls actually succeeded (message reply + case generation both returned real content), so the id is currently accepted, but it's worth confirming vs the emergentintegrations model catalog.
server.py L337 return annotation '(str, Dict[str,str])' is still a tuple literal, not typing.Tuple. Harmless, stylistic.
server.py _normalize_generated: 'exactly one correct' logic sets first option correct when none is marked, then de-dupes any additional correct flags — good defensive normalization for LLM output.
server.py /api/tts: silent fallback to {audio: null} on any exception is friendly for the client but hides breakages; consider logging the exception message body (already done via logger.error).
Odontogram legend text is not localized (hard-coded 'finding/normal/n/a'). Minor.
Simulation.jsx speakPatient always calls api.tts even if voice is OFF? No — early return when !voiceOn is correct.
Landing.jsx uses toast.error string but not the t() dictionary key — inline translation, acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Sessions & generated cases created dynamically via API during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL loaded from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (fallback to /app/frontend/.env). All expected data-testids present: generate-case-btn, case-card-<id>, phase-step-{muayene|testler|tani|tedavi}, exam-<id>, test-<id>, xray-image-<testId>, xray-opt-<testId>-<optId>, xray-explanation-<testId>, tooth-marker-<n>, dx-<id>, tx-<id>, dim-<id>, xray-finding-<i>, total-score, voice-toggle. Cracked-tooth quick sanity: dx=cracked_tooth, tx=crown, xrays periapical_xray→fracture, bitewing→normal. Generation may take ~15-30s; retry once if 502.
